facts.fact_text: The applicant did not deny that he had taken part in the demonstrations referred to by the Malatya public prosecutor.
The applicant did not deny that he had taken part in the press conferences referred to by the Malatya public prosecutor.

On 23 June 2011 the Malatya Assize Court convicted the applicant under Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code (Law no. 5237) of being a member of an armed terrorist organisation, namely the PKK (the Workers' Party of Kurdistan).

The bill of indictment filed by the Malatya public prosecutor on 10 June 2010 charged the applicant, along with eight others, with being a member of an armed terrorist organisation, namely the PKK (the Workers' Party of Kurdistan), under Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code (Law no. 5237).
The bill of indictment filed by the Malatya public prosecutor on 10 June 2010 also charged the applicant under section 5 of the Law on the Prevention of Terrorism.
